context.text:
## Task
An anonymous black-box function of 6 continuous inputs in [0, 1]; lower is better. Each evaluation also returns the constraint metric(s) `c`; see Outputs for the feasibility rule.

## Inputs
| parameter | type | domain | scale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x_c34` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_a87` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_96a` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_f46` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_80f` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_d80` | real | [0, 1] | linear |

## Outputs
- `y`: objective; minimize (lower is better).
- `c`: constraint; feasible iff `c <= 1`.

Only feasible evaluations count toward the best value found.

## Noise
Observations are noiseless: repeated evaluations of the same input return the same value.

notebook.text: Plan: 6-D box, minimize y, constraint c<=1, noiseless, budget 30, simple regret. Open with ~6 Sobol space-filling points to map the landscape and check where c is feasible; then switch to GP-driven logei, checking cv_r2 before trusting suggestions. Expect to spend a few more exploratory evals, then focus on the best feasible region and refine locally near the end.

Breakthrough: trial 6 feasible (c=0.815, y=-0.031) with x_f46=0.058 — the lowest x_f46 tested; all 6 infeasible points had x_f46>=0.11. So low x_f46 helps feasibility. But note y is NOT monotone in x_f46: best y so far is -0.478 (trial 1, x_f46=0.30, infeasible c=1.56); at x_f46=0.058 y was only -0.03. So y-optimum and feasibility region may differ; need the GP to disentangle. Plan: exploit feasible region while probing y-structure, prefer points with low x_f46 and good predicted y.

Calibration: y-model tracks well near the base (x_a87 and x_d80 drive y). c-model under-predicted in the x_a87/x_c34 directions (predicted 0.945 vs observed 1.145 at x_a87=0.7; predicted 1.25 vs observed 1.61 at x_c34=0.9), so target predicted c ~0.85-0.9 for a real margin. Known feasible base: t7 (x_a87=0.335, x_d80=0.5, x_f46=0.06): c=0.902, y=-0.118. Slice t6/t7/t8: c rises ~+0.24 per x_a87 0.335->0.7 and ~+0.09 per x_d80 0.2->0.5. x_f46 effect in feasible region untested -> boundary test at x_f46=0.

Calibrated local slopes near the feasible pocket (x_80f=0.579, x_96a=0.204, x_c34=0.565, x_f46=0.06): x_d80: dy=-0.294/unit, dc=+0.294/unit; x_a87: dy=-0.441/unit, dc=+0.666/unit. So x_d80 is the efficient y-per-c direction (1.0 vs 0.66). x_f46 confirmed flat near 0 (t10: c 1.138 at 0.0 vs 1.145 at 0.06). c34=0.565 looks like a c-minimum (raw data: c=1.87-2.05 at c34 0.06-0.14 and 0.97). Feasible pocket appears to be a true local c-min basin with c=0.815 at core (a87=0.335, d80=0.204). Plan: push x_d80 0.5->0.75 at a87=0.335 (GP: y~-0.175, c~0.977); then if feasible, optimize the c-budget trade; also one probe along t1 direction to check whether the y~-0.48 basin is reachable feasibly.

Basin check: c-model (cv_r2 0.87) maps the y~-0.47 basin (t1 region: high x_96a, low x_a87) at c>=1.33 everywhere — prob feasible <1e-4. y-model there is confident (t1 reproduces). The only feasible region appears to be the low-x_96a pocket (c-min 0.815). Marginal y gains in the pocket are now small (t13->t14: -0.004 for c +0.02). Plan: ONE transition probe at (0.5,0.5,0.4,0.565,0.3,0.06), predicted c=1.08/y=-0.16, to verify the c-surface between the basins. If c<=~1.02 there -> feasible corridor exists, pivot to basin B (big win potential). If c~1.05-1.15 -> model confirmed, spend remaining budget polishing the pocket frontier.
